name: 18917-prefillheavy-qwen3next80b-tp4
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct, bf16. Do not substitute another checkpoint. ~160 GB of weights, ~40 GB per card at TP4.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, NVLink, of one a3 node -- half the node. No router, no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 512 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no shared prefix and no prefix buckets: 1024 prompt tokens (stdev 0) against exactly 128 output tokens (stdev 0), `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0`, seed 18917.
purpose: An enterprise document summarizer turning 1000-word passages into short briefs for 16 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# `sglang serve` CLI form: one `key: value` per line. An indented or nested block is DROPPED
# silently, so every value has to stay on a single line.
# page_size is 1 here, which is what makes server_args' `chunked_prefill_size % page_size` and,
# under extra_buffer, `mamba_track_interval % page_size` asserts pass.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct
tp-size: 4
chunked-prefill-size: 2048
mamba-scheduler-strategy: extra_buffer
mamba-track-interval: 128
disable-radix-cache: true
random-seed: 18917
